headline: Ghana Annual Inflation Rises Marginally to 5.5% in October
summary: Ghana's year-on-year inflation rate edged up to 5.5% in October from 5.2% in September, driven by rising transport, housing, and food prices.
why: Inflation figures are critical for central bank policymaking, influencing interest rate decisions and currency valuation in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Higher inflation puts pressure on domestic purchasing power and influences monetary policy.
